title: Oaths of Conviction - Liege
description:
You have sworn righteous oaths and service to a liege; name them now: ___pln:leader/institution/organization__.

You start with all five of the following oaths marked. As long as you uphold an oath, you can use its benefit:
pick: Bravery (Always be the first one in and the last one out). When you **Defy Danger**, treat any 6- as 7-9
Mercy (Never take a life). Max uses equal to twice your WIS (min 1). Mark to touch someone with a bare hand and restore 1 HP. Regain all uses when you finish **Making Camp**
Protection (Never let an innocent die in your presence). Your weapon deals **holy** DMG and add +1 to your armor
Purity (Never trick or deceive). You're immune to all diseases and you can mark a Condition to cure someone else's disease

Retribution (Never let an evildoer go unpunished). You can mark a Condition to perceive creatures with evil intent up to **near** you. When you **declare someone to have evil intent**, from now on they suffer 1d4 DMG **piercing** whenever they inflict **DMG** on you or your **close** allies

submoves.title: Broken Oaths
submoves.description: When you **break an oath** (your call), clear that oath and lock a Condition. When you **find a way to atone** (also your call), clear a Condition and mark a cleared oath.
